data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million, (2017: GBP 11.2 million favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 369.552m. During 2018 the Syndicate recognised a very small gross movement in prior year provisions (gross +GBP 0.002m, i.e. a negligible strengthening). The year also included a large reinsurance-to-close (RITC) take-on of reserves which materially increased total gross claims outstanding at year end, but the specified prior-year-only movement (the "change in prior year provisions" line) is immaterial. Net commentary in the report references favourable net prior-year movements (GBP 0.4m net) after reinsurance. Overall the portfolio shows favourable net development but an essentially flat-to-negligible gross prior year movement, with major balance-sheet movements driven by RITC and reinsurance positions.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million, (2017: GBP 11.2 million favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding - 2017 comparative). Prior-year development (gross) taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' row in the Technical Provisions note (gross = GBP 2k). The report also shows a large RITC take-on of GBP 1,251,064k which materially increases year-end gross reserves and can distort development analyses; the narrative sentence quoting a GBP 0.4m favourable movement is NET of reinsurance. Some segmental premium lines show negative gross written amounts (adjustments); gross premium mix copied from the underwriting analysis note. Claims development triangle is present but contains large RITC inflows; triangle cells not fully populated in the printed image-cells not visible have been left null in the triangle data.
